# Dependency pins applied on top of the pinned envoyproxy/gateway release
# (ENVOY_GATEWAY_VERSION) to remediate CVEs in the bundled image.
#
# Each entry is the minimum version this image requires. `go mod tidy` settles
# whatever else has to move, so a module that only changes as a consequence of
# a pin does not belong here -- recording it would turn an incidental bump into
# a permanent floor that nobody can tell apart from a deliberate one. Bumping
# x/text, for example, also advances x/mod and x/tools because its go.mod
# requires them, and neither is pinned.
#
# golang.org/x/net v0.56.0 clears GO-2026-5942: a panic parsing an invalid SVCB
# or HTTPS DNS record in x/net/dns/dnsmessage. Envoy Gateway v1.8.2 still ships
# v0.55.0. The earlier CVE-2026-33814, fixed in v0.53.0, is already in the
# v1.8.2 baseline.
#
# golang.org/x/text v0.39.0 clears CVE-2026-56852 / GO-2026-5970: an infinite
# loop in norm.Iter on invalid UTF-8, reachable from the gateway-api schema
# validation path.
golang.org/x/net v0.56.0
golang.org/x/text v0.39.0
# github.com/docker/cli was advanced by an earlier revision of this patch;
# v1.8.2 already ships a safe version, so it produces no hunk today.
github.com/docker/cli v29.6.0
